integrity: Analytic derivation is recorded with classical asymptotic inputs, finite checks are distinguished from proofs, and independent mathematical verification has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Fixed alpha>-1, c>0, theta real in the weighted analytic disk setting; no joint parameter-uniformity, finite-index sign classification or exact zero-eigenvalue classification. Equivalent statements could exist in earlier oscillatory Toeplitz/Mellin research. The finite checker does not prove infinite asymptotics.
title: Balanced signed logarithmic Weyl law for boundary-chirp Bergman Toeplitz operators
